title: savannah brown - "on the fear"
text:
as a kid I’d get a new journal every so often and decide this journal to be the one. perfect! pristine! it would contain only beautiful thoughts in my tidiest handwriting and every page would be full. naturally this never happened. if I spelled a word wrong in pen, whatever, I’d get frustrated and ditch the whole notebook. wasteful little wench. obviously here the notebook is your body of work and, in a real way, your one, unditachable life. you don’t get another and you will mess up and still you must go again. you simply cannot let yourself be so paralyzed by fear that you don’t even interact with the blankness. now when I get a new notebook – this is completely true – I intentionally fuck it up, write something sloppy, spill coffee on it, tear pages out unprecisely. and too will your work live like this.

from member's only patreon post, Monday October 16th 2023

title: savannah brown - "on the fear"
text: all this to say the belief you’ve developed out of politeness and social grace that you’re not extraordinary, your willingness to let the anecdote trail off because you knew it wasn’t any good anyway – it does nothing for you, this meek fear, at home in the same filthy hovel as shame. they are parasites. they slow your creative heart to a crawl, moving towards the actualization of nothing.
